releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.36:
- Zero Setup Screen Interruption: Existing operational installations with SQLite database automatically bypass the setup wizard and boot directly into the cashier register (caja_v14.html).
- Guaranteed Express Server Startup: The application polls and confirms port 3000 is active and listening before navigating, eliminating white loading screens and ECONNREFUSED timeouts.
- 3 Dedicated Operational Roles: Station setup wizard offers: 1) All-in-One: Main Register & Server (Recommended), 2) Dedicated Server / Back Office Only, 3) Secondary Station (Register 2, Kitchen, Bar).
- Pre-Seeded Station Configuration: Bundled station_config.json pre-configured for out-of-the-box Main Cashier functionality.
- Ultra-Fast Native Thermal Printing: Native rawprint.exe Windows driver prints receipts in 0.2s.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
